Kwame, I've booked the Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 (Chicago time), with you and Bettina Kroll.

I left your night-dispatch contact's name out of the event notes. The invite goes to Bettina as well, and you told me that name in a direct message. If you want it on the invite, tell me to add it, or add it yourself in the event.
